State of South Carolina
May 5, 1972
OFFICE OF THE GOVERNOR
DIVISION OF ADMINISTRATION
WADE HAMPTON BUILDING
COLUMBIA 29201
RICHARD F. MARR
Chief, Office of Environmental Quality Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife U. S. Department of the Interior Washington, D. C. 20240
Ref: Draft Environmental Statement,
DES 72-44, Proposed Endangered Species Conservation Act of 1972.
Dear Sir:
JOHN C. WEST
GOVERNOR
The referenced statement has been received and processed by the State Clearing-house in accordance with the procedures set forth in the Office of Management and Budget Circular A-95. The draft statement was referred to the following agencies: Wildlife Resources Department, Parine Resources Division: Wildlife Resources Department; Water Resources Commission; State Development Board; State Forestry Commission; State Board of Health; State Highway Department; Department of Parks, Recreation and Tourism; Recreation Commission; Soil and Water Conservation Commission; Office of Planning, Division of Administration; and all District Clearinghouses.
Enclosed are the comments made by the Marine Resources Division, Forestry Commission, Pee Dee Regional Planning and Development Council, Waccamaw Regional Planning and Development Council, and the Berkeley-Charleston-Dorchester Regional Planning Commission.
If I can be of any further assistance, please contact me.
Sincerely,
Elmer C. Whitten Jr. Program Coordinator
